pc_slide.architecture: single flat internal sliding shelf; open PC case bolts directly to shelf; no drawer box and no lift-out sled architecture
pc_slide.slide_pair: simple 300 mm-class full-extension ball-bearing side-mount slides
pc_slide.stowed_retention_concept: one simple captive M6 thumb screw, spring pin or equivalent positive stop; exact hardware TBD
pc_slide.service_access: raise and positively secure playfield; release stowed retainer; slide PC shelf toward cabinet center; service from above
pc_slide.complete_removal: use slide disconnect feature if supplied; lift shelf + bolted open PC case out through raised playfield opening
pc_slide.case_mounting: open PC case bolts directly to sliding shelf; no second removable sled between case and shelf
pc_slide.case_mounting_holes_status: BLOCKED until actual open PC case is purchased and measured
pc_slide.slide_mounting_holes_status: BLOCKED until actual slide pair is purchased and measured
pc_slide.cable_policy: PC power/video/USB/network harnesses use service loops long enough for full 300 mm slide travel without unplugging for routine service
pc_slide.rule: keep the mechanism intentionally simple: one flat shelf + two slides + one positive stowed retainer
